original.target_description: Original source located; page 17 RFA ANOVA and pairwise contrasts; requested test statistic does not uniquely identify a contrast.

notes: Source title and DOI match the original reference. The supplied description names a family of stress/asymmetry/cortisol analyses, without specifying the critical electrode pair, phase, outcome index, or test contrast. No target chosen from audit ID, input order, or numeric matching. Explicit final analysis sample candidate: N=21 male participants, following exclusion of N=2 for premature CPT termination and N=1 for excessive movement artifacts (Methods 2.1, PDF p.8). Methods 2.9 (PDF p.13) explicitly calls N=21 the final sample size for the RFA repeated-measures analysis. This is a printed final N, not an N derived from df or a sum. Retained only as a candidate because exact row/test correspondence is unresolved; participant count is distinct from EEG epochs excluded for artifacts. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders only. PDF p.17, section 3.2 contains multiple tests: omnibus LOCATION F[1,20]=7.88, p=.011; CONDITION*TIME F[1,20]=5.38, p=.031; CONDITION*LOCATION F[1,20]=7.88, p=.011; TIME*LOCATION F[1,20]=4.80, p=.041; three-way interaction F[1,20]=3.57, p=.073; CONDITION*TIME at F7/F8 F[1,20]=5.25, p=.033 and F3/F4 F[1,20]=3.39, p=.080; intervention stress/control contrast F7/F8 t[20]=2.67, p=.015 and F3/F4 t[20]=1.17, p=.256. These are distinct same-test candidate pairs, all p values printed as equality, not bounds. No selection justified by broad description.
